The winners share their prize with the other team.
The losing team practices quietly for next year.
The judge announces that the real winner is friendship. Both teams groan. The judge laughs.
A coconut rolls away with the score sheet attached. Nobody can prove who won. Everyone goes home happy.

intro.name: The games
intro.text:
The Isolan neighbors have invited the village to an afternoon of games. Nobody is entirely sure who suggested the event, but both communities seem eager to participate.
The visiting organizers have prepared {A}.

ask.name: How to play
ask.text: A neutral visitor agrees to keep score. Both teams promise to follow the rules, although one player is already asking whether the rules are negotiable.

choices.label: Mix the teams for a cooperative round.
Ask the children to invent an extra challenge.

c1.text: The village wins narrowly. The Isolans request a rematch.

c2.text: The Isolans win decisively. The village congratulates them.

c3.text: The game ends in a tie. Both teams demand a recount.

c4.text: A player accidentally drops the coconut at the finish line. The judge applies the rule consistently.

u1.text: The teams cheer for each other's successes.

u2.text: A participant makes a spectacularly silly mistake and laughs harder than anyone else.

u3.text: The competitors forget to keep score. The judge shrugs and declares the afternoon a success.

m1.text: The villagers discover that working together is easier than shouting instructions across the field.

m2.text: The teams invent clever strategies by combining different strengths.

m3.text: A minor disagreement is resolved by changing roles and trying again.

k1.text: The children invent a perfectly reasonable new game.

k2.text: The children insist that everyone hop on one foot while carrying a spoon. The adults regret agreeing.

k3.text: The children declare that the winners must sing a song about the losers. The judge vetoes the rule.

k4.text: The children make the adults solve a puzzle they finished hours ago. The adults struggle terribly.
